d: Elsewedy Electric PSP is seeking a highly experienced Associate Project Manager to lead the successful execution of Substation projects. The role requires strong leadership, project management expertise, and the ability to deliver projects within budget, schedule, quality, and safety requirements.
q: Bachelor’s Degree in Electrical or Mechanical Engineering.
Strong knowledge of project management principles and EPC project execution.
Excellent leadership, communication, negotiation, and planning skills.
Proficiency in project management and reporting tools.
Minimum 12 years of experience in substation project.
At least 5 years of experience leading teams of senior engineers.
Proven track record of successfully delivering large-scale substation projects.
In-depth knowledge of Qatar regulatory frameworks, legal requirements, and market obligations.
r: Lead and manage the execution of substation projects from initiation through commissioning.
Develop and implement project execution plans to achieve project objectives.
Manage project budgets, schedules, resources, and contractual requirements.
Coordinate engineering, procurement, construction, and commissioning activities.
Build and maintain effective relationships with clients, consultants, subcontractors, and other stakeholders.
Manage project risks, variations, and change orders.
Ensure compliance with HSE, quality, and company standards.
Lead and mentor multidisciplinary project teams to achieve operational excellence.
Monitor project performance and provide regular updates to senior management.
Support tendering activities and contribute to technical and commercial proposals when required.

d: As a PS Core 2nd Level Operations professional, you will help deliver reliable, high-quality network services by coordinating and performing configuration, operations, and maintenance activities in line with agreed service levels. You will work across PS Core platforms to maintain service performance, resolve issues, and support customer needs.
q: A degree in Electrical Engineering, Telecommunications Engineering, Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related field.
+7 years of relevant experience in the PS Core domain, with a strong understanding of 2G, 4G, and 5G network architecture, interfaces, protocols, and signaling flows, including 5G Standalone (SA).
Hands-on experience commissioning, configuring, troubleshooting, operating, and maintaining Ericsson vEPC platforms, including SGSN-MME and EPG.
Experience configuring, operating, and maintaining IPWorks e-DNS/i-DNS and Infoblox DNS.
Experience with ePDG, vWMG, SAPC, AAA/RADIUS servers, Internet DNS, Wi-Fi solutions, TCP optimization, and Quality of Service (QoS).
Knowledge of managed-services operations in the telecommunications industry and Ericsson ways of working.
Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills, with the ability to collaborate, share knowledge, and work effectively with others.
A customer-focused, results-oriented approach, with the ability to apply expertise, meet commitments, and contribute to innovation and continuous improvement.
